title: Show memories on the screen: a third view with a preview and a page

notes.author: Jack Roddy/42dfd115
notes.text: Design, proposed 2026-10-09: View gets a Memories variant and Tab cycles list, board, memories. Rows are slug, age, first line of text; the preview pane shows the whole text through the markdown renderer plus branch @ commit and how far behind. Memories marked old or from another branch, by the same rule prime.rs uses, get a dim badge. / filters on slug and text. Enter opens a page: a card with the slug and stamp, the text at full width.
